survivors_flagged.one_line: IPO of the North American gold unit (NGM + Pueblo Viejo + Fourmile) targeted for end-2026 but slipping to Jan-2027; widely known, some shareholders oppose it; a real sum-of-parts unlock, but late-arc and famous.

Aquarian $70 cash deal still pending (DE/NY/MA insurance approvals); outside date auto-extended to 2026-12-06; stock ~$43.7, a ~60% gross spread, so the market prices heavy break/financing risk. Complicated arb with a hard date; verify the cause of the spread before seating.

QUELL-CV Ph2 topline (hsCRP endpoint, a low bar given Ph1 showed hsCRP normalization) is due H2-2026. Stock is down ~80% on read-across from Novo's NLRP3 class failure, so asymmetry looks mispriced and unmoved. Exact date unconfirmed.

BIP/BIPC collapse into one Canadian corporation (BIP Inc.) was approved by unitholders 10/14 and is expected to close Q4-2026. The new vehicle is index- and ETF-eligible, giving a possible index-inclusion flow; the announcement (Jul-26) is partly priced.

Tinlarebant (Stargardt) NDA has Priority Review, PDUFA 2027-02-12, after a positive Ph3 DRAGON (-35.7% lesion growth). The stock fell ~7% on acceptance, so not run up; early-arc binary about 3 months out.

verified.catalyst: Barrick Mining plans an IPO of a minority stake in "North American Barrick" (its 61.5% of Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo and the Fourmile project). The primary listing would be in New York with a secondary in Toronto. The aim is to mark a market value on the Tier-1 North American gold assets and narrow the conglomerate discount.
verified.dated_milestone: Q2-2026 release (Aug 2026) said the IPO was on track for end-2026. Bloomberg (2026-09-03) and CEO Mark Hill (2026-09-30) both flagged a possible slide to Jan-2027. Next checkpoints: Q3-2026 results (expected early-mid Nov 2026), then the IPO registration filing and pricing (Dec-2026 to Jan-2027).
verified.bloom_gates: G1 yes: Newmont consented in Aug-2026, with Fourmile moved into NGM and a $1.95B cash top-up paid to Barrick, and the new company has a named CEO (Hill). G2 partial: management committed to completing the IPO by end-2026 / Jan-2027, but there is no filed registration statement, offer size or stake percentage. G3 fails: there is no specific unpriced figure, such as an IPO valuation or proceeds-use commitment.
verified.edge: L. Run-up from the pre-catalyst base (about $33.06 on 2025-11-03, before split reports and the Feb-2026 go-ahead) to $38.38 today is about +16%, mostly gold beta: the stock peaked at $54.69 and is now below its 50d/200d averages of about $42. Remaining capture to a provenance-checked value cannot be derived. An IPO of a minority stake moves no cash to the common, and the upside depends on the market re-rating the stub, not on any contractual figure. There is no IPO valuation to set against the about $63B market cap. The event is famous, well telegraphed and slipping, and the stock trades as a gold proxy.
verified.primary_source: Barrick Q2-2026 results release (barrick.com, Aug 2026). Engineering News, 2026-08-11 (Newmont deal clears path) and 2026-09-30 (Hill: IPO could slide into January). Miningmx/Bloomberg, 2026-09-03 (may delay to 2027). FMP quote and EOD history, 2026-11-02.
verified.analysis: The event is real and dated: Newmont's consent removed the main legal blocker, Barrick says it is still targeting end-2026, and the CEO allows for Jan-2027. Large holders VanEck and Mackenzie oppose it. The upside is a derived sum-of-parts re-rating with no IPO size or valuation disclosed, so the numerator cannot be re-derived from the capital structure. The equity is a gold-beta play, not an event payoff. I did not check the 10-Q (no pref stack is expected at Barrick), and Q3-2026 results were not found, so the latest IPO status after 2026-09-30 is unverified.

verified.catalyst: Pending $70/sh all-cash merger with an Aquarian Capital affiliate. Closing waits on insurance Form A approvals in Delaware, New York and Massachusetts, and the outside date has auto-extended to 2026-12-06.
verified.dated_milestone: Outside date 2026-12-06 (auto-extended from 2026-09-06). Next date: the Delaware DOI public hearing on the Form A, which must precede the Commissioner's Final Order and was unscheduled as of the Aug-Sep 2026 reporting. Q3 2026 results are also due in early November.
verified.bloom_gates: G1 (named counterparty Aquarian, with Sixth Street/Talcott a named fallback bidder per Bloomberg 2026-09-22). G2 (signed merger agreement at $70 cash, stockholder-approved 2026-02-12, HSR expired, FINRA approved 2026-05-19). G3 partial: the $70 is contractual, but the spread is a priced break risk rather than an unpriced figure.
verified.edge: L-M. The spread is explained, not mispriced. Delaware DOI publicly confirmed a formal Form A review (2026-08-17) and had no hearing date. Per Bloomberg, the regulator questioned Aquarian founder Sahay on sources of capital and balance-sheet plans. There is also an accounting question around Brighthouse Reinsurance Co of Delaware (SA 2026-08-07). Residual capture: (a) run-up from the pre-catalyst base is about -16%: the undisturbed price was about $51.80 (deal at a 35.14% premium), and today is $43.69, so the stock trades BELOW undisturbed. (b) Remaining to the contractual $70 is +60%. With an estimated break value of about $35-40, the market implies roughly a 15-25% close probability. EV is only modestly positive unless you hold a differentiated view on Delaware, with optionality from Talcott/Sixth Street re-bidding.
verified.primary_source: BHF 10-Q for Q2 2026 (SEC, period ended 2026-06-30): outside-date auto-extension to 2026-12-06 and remaining DE/NY/MA approvals. Delaware DOI release 2026-08-17 (news.delaware.gov): Form A review, hearing not scheduled. Bloomberg 2026-09-22: Sixth Street renews bid as the Aquarian deal faces review. FMP quote 2026-11-02: $43.69.
verified.analysis: The deal and its dates are real and forward, but the 60% gross spread is not a mispricing to exploit. It is the market pricing a probable regulatory break or renegotiation. Delaware is scrutinizing Aquarian's capital sources and the BRCD reinsurance affiliate, and no hearing was scheduled as of the latest reporting. That makes a close by 2026-12-06 unlikely without a further extension, and the stock has fallen from a ~$59 200-day average to below its undisturbed price. WATCH, not ACTIVE: re-score on (1) Delaware scheduling the Form A hearing, (2) an amendment or extension of the outside date or a price cut, or (3) a formal Talcott/Sixth Street bid. GAP: no October 2026 primary-source news was found, NY DFS/MA status is unverified, and the break value is estimated rather than derived from the 10-Q.

verified.catalyst: The company has guided topline data for H2-2026 from QUELL-CV, a Phase 2 trial of BGE-102 (oral NLRP3 inhibitor) in about 160 obese, inflamed adults on 30/60/90mg versus placebo. The primary endpoint is percent change in hsCRP at 12 weeks.
verified.dated_milestone: Company guidance is QUELL-CV topline in H2-2026, reaffirmed in the Q2-26 release dated 2026-08-05. There is no exact date and no enrollment-complete notice yet. First patient was dosed in June 2026 and dosing runs 12 weeks, so the year-end window is tight and a slip into Q1-2027 is a real risk. The next checkpoint is the Q3-26 10-Q/PR in early-to-mid November 2026, which should confirm the timing. QUELL-DME data is due mid-2027.
verified.bloom_gates: G2 holds: a concrete company-guided readout window with a defined endpoint, dose arms and n. G3 holds: the company trades below cash. The 2026-11-02 market cap was $212.7M against $381M cash at Q2-26, or roughly $354M after about $27M of Q3 burn (my estimate). That is about 0.6x net cash, or about $9.4/share of cash against a $5.65 price. G1 does not apply (in-house asset, no named counterparty event).
verified.edge: M. Run-up from the pre-catalyst base is about -65%, not a run-up. The trial was public from the 2025 R&D day, and the stock has fallen from a 52-week high of $25.96 (about $16 pre-ZEUS) to $5.65. So there is no harvest: the event is unpriced, and the tape even discounts it below cash. Remaining capture to favorable resolution is about +95%, from $5.65 to about $11 (estimated cash per share of about $9.4 plus a modest pipeline premium). Downside on a miss or slip is about -20%, to a floor near $4.5. The cash floor is the real edge. The weak point is the endpoint itself. The triage note calls ZEUS an "NLRP3 class failure", but ziltivekimab is an IL-6 antibody, so the read-across is to the inflammation-CV hypothesis, not to the NLRP3 mechanism. Because ZEUS failed on MACE despite lowering inflammation markers, a clean hsCRP hit now re-rates less than it would have pre-July. The binary is mostly worth "back to cash", not a full re-rate.
verified.primary_source: BioAge Q2-2026 results PR and 10-Q (2026-08-05, sec.gov bioa-20260630.htm): QUELL-CV design, H2-2026 topline guidance, $381M cash. Sahm Capital (2026-07-31): stock drop on Novo ZEUS Phase 3 failure; Jefferies target cut $62 to $21. FMP quote 2026-11-02: $5.65, market cap $212.7M.
verified.analysis: The catalyst is real, dated to a half-year window, forward and unfired, and it is not a macro bet. The stock trades at about 0.6x estimated net cash (I derived share count of about 37.6M from market cap; dilution since Q2 is not verified). That gives asymmetry with a cash-backed floor. hsCRP reduction is a low bar given the Phase 1 hsCRP data. Two things keep this at WATCH rather than ACTIVE. First, there is no exact date and timing risk is material: dosing started in June, enrollment completion is unconfirmed, and dosing is 12 weeks. Second, after ZEUS the hsCRP surrogate carries less valuation weight, so even a positive readout mostly closes the cash discount. Biggest gaps: the Q3-26 cash balance and share count, and whether a cash burn path or ATM use erodes the floor. Re-check after the Q3 print.

Before that, the BIPC shareholder vote was on 2026-10-29 (adjourned from 10-14) and its result is unconfirmed. Close is targeted for Q4-2026. verified.instrument: BIP common units (NYSE/TSX), $37.84 on 2026-11-02. BIPC trades at $37.97, near 1:1 parity, so the BIPC exchange spread offers nothing.
verified.bloom_gates: G2 only: the structure change is concrete, dated and approved, and its last step is the court order. G1 fails because there is no named counterparty or buyer. G3 fails because no index is named and there is no estimate of passive demand; the issuer only says "potential additional index inclusion", so the upside cannot be put in figures.
verified.edge: L. The event itself is near-certain to close, but the payoff is a fuzzy passive-flow story that cannot be put in figures, not a re-rating tied to a contract. (a) Run-up from before the announcement: -7.4%. The 2026-07-24 close was $40.88. The price spiked to $42.62 on 07-29, then gave the spike back; it is now $37.84. The "partly priced" claim in the triage is not supported: the stock trades below where it was before the event. (b) Remaining capture to a favorable outcome: cannot be quantified. There is no contractual value, and the numerator cannot be derived from the capital structure, because simplification changes the wrapper, not net asset value (NAV). Any index-flow uplift is a few-percent multiple effect at most, and nothing confirms it.
verified.primary_source: BIP press release "Unitholders Approve Proposed Corporate Simplification", 2026-10-14 (finviz.com/news/402770). BIPC new-meeting-date release, Oct-2026 (finviz.com/news/401032). BIPC 6-K ex99-2 on SEC EDGAR (0001788348/000110465926103589). Original announcement at bip.brookfield.com, Jul-2026. FMP BIP EOD prices for 2026-07-20 to 08-05 and quote on 2026-11-02.
verified.analysis: The simplification is real and nearly done. BIP's approval is in hand (more than 99% of votes cast), and per BIP's FAQ the BIP leg does not depend on the BIPC vote. Only the BC court final order (~11-03) and the Q4 close remain. The flagged upside is unspecified index-inclusion flow on top of an unchanged asset base. The structure change creates no NAV, so I am scoring the equity, not the event, and capping the score at 4. The BIPC 10-29 vote result and the court date are unconfirmed (single secondary source). Lookup budget gap: I did not check the preferred stack ahead of the common (BIP LP preferreds and perpetual subordinated notes moving into BIP Inc.) or any change to the Brookfield incentive distribution. No upside figure depends on that check.
